description: This is a Java enum class defining a well-known MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) key related to connectivity, specifically for use in logging or context management within the connectivity module of a project.

classes.name: ConnectivityMdcEntryKey
classes.description: An enum implementing CharSequence that defines a specific MDC key for connection ID in connectivity-related logging or context.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index of the key.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the key string between the specified start and end indices.
